title: Chocolate Muffins with Ganache
description: Tall domes like bakery royalty, fluffy like a hymn, dipped in butter-rich ganache — decadent perfection.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 175°C. Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, bi-carb soda, and instant coffee.
In another bowl, whisk together melted butter, oil, eggs, milk, cream, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients. Stir gently until just combined — do not overmix. A few small lumps are fine.
Fold in chocolate chips gently with a spatula.
Fill muffin cups about three-quarters full using a large spoon or ice cream scoop.
Bake for 22–25 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out with just a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before dipping in ganache.
For the ganache: Heat cream in a small saucepan until steaming but not boiling.
Place chopped chocolate in a heatproof bowl and pour the hot cream over it.
Let sit for 5 minutes without stirring, then stir gently from the centre outward until smooth and glossy.
Add softened butter and stir until fully incorporated and silky. Add vanilla extract and instant coffee if using.
Let ganache rest until it reaches desired consistency: 10–15 minutes for dipping, longer for spreading.
Dip muffin domes directly into the ganache or spoon ganache over the tops.
Chill briefly in the refrigerator for 10–15 minutes if you want the ganache to set firmly.

notes.title: Tall Domes
notes.content: If the muffins do not dome beautifully, increase the oven temperature by 10–20°C for the first 5 minutes of baking, then reduce to 175°C for the remainder.

notes.title: Soft Texture
notes.content: Add an extra tablespoon of oil if you prefer an ultra-soft, tender crumb. These muffins are intentionally soft — if they feel crumbly when cold, reduce baking time by 2–3 minutes next time.
